payload.description: Reproduced failure across 2 executions with identical context.
payload.action: Review Loop iteration 1 finding detected: FIND-R3-001-01
symptoms: The unconditional `git config --global --add safe.directory` in _reusable_origin is executed by the new real-git unit tests (test_second_pass_reuses_the_clone_and_discards_leaked_state, test_real_origin_mismatch_is_wiped_and_recloned_from_the_configured_remote), appending stale tmp-path entries to the runner's real ~/.gitconfig on every run — state leaking outside tmp_path, against the PR's hermetic-test constraint. Isolate git global config in the tests (GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/HOME monkeypatch) and/or scope the write to sandboxed runs.
